content: Ambient-product and accessibility sources favor a small control set: Rusty's Retirement provides zoom and focus controls; WCAG requires control over auto-moving or auto-updating content and supports resuming from the paused point or returning to current state depending on whether content is real time; YouTube links specific moments back to their source. The MVP should offer pan/zoom, follow resident, global pause for reading, jump to live, transcript/recent-scenes access, and scene permalinks, not game controls.
